cues: Do not define osmosis as water moving from a dilute to a concentrated solution.
That fails the moment pressure acts, and every turgid cell is under pressure.
Define it with water potential: water moves from higher, less negative, to lower, more negative water potential.
text: Exam tip. Do not define osmosis as water moving from a dilute to a concentrated solution. That fails the moment pressure acts, and every turgid cell is under pressure. Define it with water potential: water moves from higher, less negative, to lower, more negative water potential.
